subject.title: [security] Worker diagnostic redaction misses passwordless URL userinfo credentials

question: Should Crabbox handle passwordless HTTP(S) URL userinfo in Worker diagnostics as an in-scope credential-redaction security fix?
rationale: The docs and CLI behavior support treating this as credential material, but security handling and any advisory/backport posture need maintainer ownership.

options.title: Fix as security bug
options.body: Update the Worker redactor and tests without adding new user-facing configuration or changing the documented boundary.

options.title: Treat as hardening only
options.body: Leave this open for lower-priority hardening if maintainers decide passwordless URL userinfo is outside the security boundary despite the current docs.

recommendation.title: Fix as security bug
recommendation.body: Update the Worker redactor and tests without adding new user-facing configuration or changing the documented boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent diagnostic-redaction implementation and security-doc history most directly tied to this boundary.
